items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Bechet had gotten out with Benny Peyton's group, Benny Peyton formed the Jazz Kings

ctx.x: Well, had Bechet stayed with Lattimore, or did he go with Cook?
No, no, he didn't stay with Lattimore. Bechet had gotten out with Benny Peyton's group, Benny Peyton formed the Jazz Kings and --
Okay, we had a little fire whistle going by. It was hard to hear.
